short_blurb: Licensed Class B builder serving Santa Clarita — remodels, ADUs & more.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Santa Clarita. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Santa Clarita, including Valencia, Saugus, Canyon Country, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Santa Clarita?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Santa Clarita building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Santa Clarita?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Santa Clarita rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Santa Clarita remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
